verdict_A_spec_source: FAIL acceptance as written; C04/C05 source coverage is present, but durable interrupted recovery is incomplete.
verdict_B_quality_safety: FAIL to accept fixture lifecycle until recovery paths are closed. No reviewed branch deletes ambiguous data, but unresolved phases can strand this fixture.

findings.finding: When create response says created=false or organization mismatches, phase becomes ownership_unverified. Cleanup explicitly skips that phase, and subsequent recovery also throws recovery_cleanup_only then skips cleanup. This avoids deleting a possibly preexisting/concurrent table, but leaves no durable resolution path if ownership can later be established.

Recovery handles an absent table only in create_sent or archive_sent. Journals in no_fixture_created or archived_verified with an absent table fall through to the exactly-one assertion and fail on every retry. These terminal phases should safely confirm absence without another write.

Journal path is derived from output path. Hosted route assigns output a run-and-attempt-specific path (scripts/hosted-showcase-route.mjs:53-56), so a new hosted retry points to a new journal and cannot automatically recover the previous interrupted run. The helper is cleanup-only when given the same journal, but the driver has no stable recovery journal input/discovery.

positive_evidence: C04/C05 use the person API's returned table and row IDs, with extension token hash checked in page context and X-Organization-Id carried on fixture requests (records-positive-fixture.mjs:19-55, 107-118).

Pre-write run-unique name and phase are journaled; interrupted create/table/row/archive phases attempt cleanup through the same person API; archival is verified by an empty filtered list (records-positive-fixture.mjs:128-223).

The native driver requires one finished Records POST with matching org/principal and exact args, parses one completion, and requires visible output equality (records-readonly-native-acceptance.mjs:254-337). C04 validates returned row/table/org/value and provenance triple; C05 validates table, count measure, and one bucket with one row/count (lines 612-689).

Existing malformed C03/C04/C05 requests remain and are recorded with positive_read_verified=false (records-readonly-native-acceptance.mjs:531-603); driver tests reject wrong positive row value and aggregate count (records-readonly-native-driver.test.mjs:824-845).
Scope remains C04/C05 only; no C11 or C06 credit.
limitations: Source-only review. No local tests, build, browser, or native actions performed per task constraints.
